responses_en:
It’s normal to feel stressed when exams and deadlines pile up. Let’s start with a few manageable steps:
• List your upcoming exams, projects, and deadlines.
• Prioritize tasks according to urgency and importance.
• Break large tasks into smaller, achievable steps.
• Study in focused intervals and take short breaks.
• Get enough sleep, eat regularly, and allow time to rest.

If your stress feels overwhelming or is affecting your daily functioning, you may reach out to the Guidance and Counseling office for additional support.

Exams can feel like a lot. Try one small step today: pick one subject, study it for 25 minutes, then take a 5-minute break. Sleep and meals matter too. Would you like to book a session with the Guidance Associate?
responses_tl:
Normal lang na ma-stress kapag sabay-sabay ang exams at deadlines. Subukan natin ito:
• Ilista ang mga paparating na exam, project, at deadline.
• Unahin ang pinaka-urgent at pinaka-importante.
• Hatiin ang malalaking gawain sa maliliit na hakbang.
• Mag-aral nang naka-focus, tapos magpahinga sandali.
• Matulog nang sapat, kumain nang maayos, at magpahinga.

Kung sobra na ang stress at naaapektuhan na ang araw-araw mo, pwede kang lumapit sa Guidance and Counseling Office para sa dagdag na suporta.

responses_en:
Thesis and capstone work can feel huge, especially with deadlines, revisions, and a group to coordinate. A few steps that help:
• Break the paper into small tasks (one section or one feature at a time) and set a date for each.
• Agree on who does what with your groupmates, write it down, and check in briefly every few days.
• Bring specific questions to your adviser early instead of waiting until the paper is "done".
• Treat panel revisions as a checklist: list them, then tick them off one by one.
• Protect your sleep and meals, and take short breaks; a tired mind writes slower.

If the stress is affecting your sleep, health, or how you get along with your group, the Guidance Associate can help. You can book a session here anytime.

Thesis stress is very common, and you don't have to carry it alone. Pick one small task you can finish today, like one paragraph or one bug, and start there. If your group is having conflicts or you feel close to burning out, would you like to book a session with the Guidance Associate?
responses_tl:
Mabigat talaga ang thesis at capstone, lalo na kapag sabay-sabay ang deadline, revisions, at pakikipag-ugnayan sa grupo. Subukan natin ito:
• Hatiin ang papel sa maliliit na gawain (isang section o isang feature muna) at lagyan ng petsa ang bawat isa.
• Pag-usapan ng grupo kung sino ang gagawa ng ano, isulat ito, at mag-check in kada ilang araw.
• Lumapit agad sa adviser na may tiyak na tanong; huwag nang hintaying "tapos" na ang papel.
• Gawing checklist ang mga revision ng panel at isa-isahin ang mga ito.
• Matulog nang sapat, kumain nang maayos, at magpahinga sandali; mas mabagal magsulat kapag pagod.

Kung naaapektuhan na ng stress ang tulog, kalusugan, o samahan ng grupo ninyo, pwede kang tulungan ng Guidance Associate. Pwede kang mag-book ng session dito anumang oras.

Normal lang ma-stress sa thesis, at hindi mo kailangang pasanin ito nang mag-isa. Pumili ng isang maliit na gawain na kaya mong tapusin ngayon, gaya ng isang talata o isang bug, at doon magsimula. Kung may hindi pagkakaunawaan sa grupo o pakiramdam mo ay malapit ka nang mag-burnout, gusto mo bang mag-book ng session sa Guidance Associate?

responses_en:
A student may be referred to the GCO by a faculty member, school staff member, parent or guardian, or another appropriate person. Students may also seek help directly.

After a referral, the GCO may:
• Review the concern and the information provided.
• Determine the urgency of the situation and the appropriate next steps.
• Contact the student and arrange an initial conversation or consultation.
• Discuss appropriate support, possible follow-up, or referral to another qualified professional or service if needed.

Referrals are handled with care and according to applicable privacy, safeguarding, and school policies. Urgent safety concerns should be addressed immediately rather than waiting for routine referral processing.
responses_tl:
Pwedeng i-refer ang estudyante sa GCO ng faculty, staff, magulang o guardian, o ibang angkop na tao. Pwede ring dumirekta ang estudyante.

Pagkatapos ng referral, ang GCO ay maaaring:
• Suriin ang concern at impormasyon.
• Alamin kung gaano ka-urgent at ang tamang susunod na hakbang.
• Kontakin ang estudyante para sa unang usapan o consultation.
• Pag-usapan ang angkop na suporta o referral sa ibang propesyonal kung kailangan.

Pwede ka ring mag-refer dito sa E-Gabay gamit ang Submit Referral. Ang urgent na safety concern ay dapat agad aksyunan.

The Guidance and Counseling Office (GCO) offers these services to students:
• Consultation: one-on-one sessions for personal, academic, social, or emotional concerns.
• Referral: connecting you to the right support when a concern needs more help.
• Career Guidance: help with choosing a strand, course, or career, including the Career Planning Program for Senior High School.
• Group Guidance: sessions on topics students need, based on needs assessments.
• Information Service: announcements and guidance resources.

• Career Guidance: tulong sa pagpili ng strand, course, o career, kasama ang Career Planning Program para sa Senior High School.
• Group Guidance: mga session sa mga paksang kailangan ng mga estudyante, batay sa needs assessment.
• Information Service: mga anunsyo at guidance resources.

• Testing Service.

Not getting enough sleep makes everything harder, from focusing in class to handling stress. A few things that help:
• Sleep and wake up at about the same time every day.
• Put your phone away 30 minutes before bed.
• Avoid coffee and energy drinks in the afternoon.
• If your mind keeps racing, write your worries down so they can wait until tomorrow.

If you've had trouble sleeping for weeks, or worries are keeping you up, talk to the Guidance Associate, and consider seeing a doctor. You can book a session with the Guidance Associate under My Appointments, or visit the Guidance and Counseling Office during office hours.

• Matulog at gumising sa halos parehong oras araw-araw.
• Itabi ang cellphone 30 minuto bago matulog.
• Iwasan ang kape at energy drinks sa hapon.
• Kung hindi tumitigil ang isip, isulat ang mga iniisip para bukas na lang harapin.
